definitions.explanation: Having many functions or capabilities. Used as a modifier (多機能の/多機能な) to describe products, devices, or systems with multiple features.

examples.japanese: {多機能|たきのう}な{時計|とけい}。
この{多機能|たきのう}ペンは{書|か}くだけでなく、タッチペンとしても{使|つか}える。
examples.english: This multi-function pen can be used not only for writing but also as a stylus.

examples.japanese: {多機能|たきのう}トイレは{車椅子|くるまいす}の{方|かた}やオストメイトにも{対応|たいおう}している。
examples.english: Multi-function restrooms accommodate wheelchair users and ostomates.

notes:
{多機能|たきのう} means 'multi-function' or 'versatile,' describing devices or systems with many features. Combines {多|た} (many) + {機能|きのう} (function).

COMPOUNDS:
- {多機能|たきのう}トイレ (multi-function/accessible restroom — increasingly preferred over {多目的|たもくてき}トイレ)
- {多機能|たきのう}プリンター (multifunction printer)
- {多機能|たきのう}{携帯|けいたい} (feature-rich mobile phone)
- {多機能|たきのう}ペン (multi-function pen)

FORMS:
- {多機能|たきのう}の + noun (no-adjective)
- {多機能|たきのう}な + noun (also used, especially in casual speech)

RELATED WORDS:
- {高機能|こうきのう}: high-performance, advanced functionality
- {単機能|たんきのう}: single-function (opposite)
- {多目的|たもくてき}: multi-purpose (similar but emphasizes purpose rather than function)
